name: Boyko Inc.

about:
Boyko Inc. was founded in August 1987 in Stanton, North Dakota, by brothers Ron and Tom Boyko as a USDA‑inspected food manufacturing plant. The family‑owned corporation initially produced bakery and meat products before expanding into additional food items.

After two decades of manufacturing, the company sold its production operations in 2006 to focus on the used equipment market. Since 1996 Boyko has bought and sold used food‑processing machinery, and by 2002 it was doing so full‑time, sourcing equipment at auctions nationwide and partnering with auction firm Schneider Industries. Today the firm operates as a distributor and service provider, offering equipment listings, consignment sales, liquidations, asset‑management programs, technical support, and process‑plant consulting for food‑processing facilities.

The company serves food‑manufacturing customers across the processing industry, helping them acquire or dispose of equipment such as mixers, ovens, conveyors, packaging lines, and freezing systems. Its client base includes plants seeking individual machines or complete production lines, though no specific customers are named in public materials.

Boyko emphasizes its manufacturing heritage as a differentiator, stating that its background gives the team a diverse understanding of the requirements, challenges, and goals of food‑processing companies. The family‑owned business cites a mission to provide efficient, reliable service with the utmost integrity.
